dataset_description: Flags dealers whose sales (turnover) are above their market's average AND whose ordering activity is low (infrequent or not recent), for a fixed 10-dealer sample, Apr-Jun 2026.

country.description: Market. Also used as the peer group for the turnover comparison.

turnover.description: Total sales amount for the dealer over the window.

invoice_count.description: Count of distinct invoices for the dealer over the window.

recency_days.description: Days between the dealer's most recent invoice and 2026-06-30.

avg_turnover.description: Average turnover across dealers in the same country (within this sample).

high_turnover.description: True if the dealer's turnover is above the country average turnover.

low_activity.description: True if the dealer has low order frequency OR poor recency.

high_turnover_low_activity_flag.description: True if the dealer is both high_turnover AND low_activity.

talking_point_generation.flagged: You sell more than the average dealer in your market, but your sales activity has gone quiet.
talking_point_generation.not_flagged: Do not raise this talking point.

llm_instructions: Only raise the talking point for dealers where high_turnover_low_activity_flag is true.
Do not raise or imply this talking point for dealers where the flag is false.
Support the statement with the dealer's actual turnover, avg_turnover, and recency_days values.
Treat this as a per-dealer conversation cue, not a ranking or prioritization across dealers.
Do not invent business reasons for why activity is low.
high_turnover_low_activity_flag may be stored as a string ('true'/'false') or boolean — treat both as equivalent.
